items.label: H.R. 2481
items.summary: The Romance Scam Prevention Act requires online dating service providers to send a fraud ban notification to any user who has exchanged messages with an account that has been banned for suspected fraud. The law establishes standard rules for what these notifications must contain, how quickly they must be sent, and provides a legal safe harbor for companies complying with the requirement. It also sets up federal and state enforcement mechanisms through the Federal Trade Commission and state attorneys general, while establishing a single national standard that overrides state-level notification laws.
items.title: Romance Scam Prevention Act

items.label: H.R. 7022
items.summary: The Mystic Alerts Act establishes rules to allow wireless emergency alerts to be transmitted to mobile devices via satellite in addition to traditional terrestrial mobile networks. Participating commercial mobile service providers can choose whether to transmit these satellite alerts, must follow technical regulations set by the FCC, and cannot charge extra fees for the service. Providers that opt out must notify their subscribers.
items.title: Mystic Alerts Act
